description: Cheapest VPS plans matching a size, budget, provider or location, cheapest first (one per provider unless exactly one provider is given).

location.description: Country, city or region slug, e.g. usa, germany, india, frankfurt, new-york, europe, asia, austria, vienna, helsinki, zurich.

managed.description: Managed hosting (Cloudways, Kinsta) instead of unmanaged servers.

min_ram_gb.description: Minimum memory in GB (0.5 for 512 MB).

min_transfer_tb.description: Minimum included monthly transfer in TB.

no_commitment.description: Leave out prices that need a prepaid term.

providers.description: Provider slugs, e.g. hetzner, digitalocean, vultr, akamai-linode, aws-lightsail, ovhcloud, contabo, netcup.

name: search_vps_plans

cite.description: Cite this first: the StackRates page that shows the answer (url) and the day its prices were read (readOn), then the provider page (sourceUrl).

title: Search VPS plans
